release_notes: Hardwired pan/tilt floodlight camera (US launch February 2026). Complete specification from the official Tapo product page spec table: sensor, 4.0 mm F2.0 lens, full FOV triplet, IR 98 ft / 30 m plus full-color night vision, 1500 lm 4000K floodlight, mechanical pan/tilt ranges, PIR coverage, 30 fps, 10.8x digital zoom, 512 GB microSD, IP65. RTSP/ONVIF listed per the mains-powered Tapo pattern with verified:false — confirm on hardware, as floodlight models occasionally differ.

frigate.notes: Mains-powered Tapo cameras expose RTSP once a Camera Account is created in the Tapo app (Settings > Advanced > Camera Account). /stream1 main, /stream2 sub. Not bench-verified on the C710 specifically. go2rtc alternative: TP-Link's proprietary protocol via go2rtc (tapo://<tapo-account-password>@{ip}) is often more stable than RTSP (fewer timeouts / non-monotonic-timestamp errors). The password form is firmware-dependent: either your Tapo app/cloud account password, or user `admin` + the UPPERCASE SHA-256 of the camera password (`tapo://admin:<UPPERCASE-SHA256>@{ip}`) — see go2rtc's Tapo docs. It is not the camera's plain RTSP/Device password. If non-monotonic-timestamp errors persist, disable audio for that camera in Frigate. Chrome may render the go2rtc live view with a squashed aspect ratio (a browser live-view quirk, not the stream); Firefox is correct. The go2rtc tapo:// source also carries a two-way-audio backchannel, so Frigate's live view gets a talk button (mic+speaker).

home_assistant.notes: Native TP-Link Tapo integration. Requires Tapo cloud account credentials.

blue_iris.notes: Use Generic/ONVIF profile. RTSP streams: /stream1 (main), /stream2 (sub). Enable the Camera Account in the Tapo app first.
